title: Watercolour Level 2 (55+)
description: Register Here! Registration for all Aurora Cultural Centre programs is on the Town of Aurora’s e-PLAY website. All programs continue to be part of the Aurora Cultural Centre. September 16 – November 25, 2025 [SKIP September 30] Tuesdays | 9:30 am – 12:00 pm | Age 55+ Aurora Town Square – Shining Hill Visual Arts Studio 50 Victoria Street, Aurora This watercolour class (for participants 55 plus) is focused on seasoned watercolour artists wishing to further develop their style and learn new techniques. Participants will learn more about the importance of values and will have exposure to many differing subjects. Graphite paper can be used to trace images or participants may choose to draw their project with guidance from the instructor as needed. Courses tailored for adults 55 plus encourage discovery, creativity and social connection in an environment that supports effective learning strategies for mature learners.
